description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/AI/CreateTask. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Creates AI optimization tasks for selected store products, including supplier-backed eBay product characteristics / item specifics. ownerAgent: optimization. Use when: Use to generate product improvements for review or optional automatic publication. Fields supports published eBay API and No API products with exact supplier associations. Input: Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Action, AutoPublish, Listings (exact ListingVariation IDs), and Settings. For Fields, up to 100 distinct products; setting PROMT accepts fields:missing (default) or fields:replace. Output: Returns Success. Fields retrieves missing supplier details through scraping and consumes AI tokens when a valid proposal is saved. No historical supplier content or pending publication originals are required. Search terms: ai createtask. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
